STEP 1 - Scene: fruit plate (snack/dessert), no protein or starch
STEP 2 - Vessel: light-blue dinner plate ~26 cm; area 3.14 x 13^2 = 530 cm^2
STEP 3 - Items: whole red apple; red grapes (~25) with 2 green grapes; cantaloupe cubes (~12 pieces)
STEP 4 - Area: apple 9%; grapes 10%; cantaloupe 8%; total 27% of vessel
STEP 5 - Volume:
- apple 48 cm^2 x 7 cm = 336 ml
- grapes 53 cm^2 x 2 cm = 106 ml
- cantaloupe 42 cm^2 x 2.5 cm = 106 ml
STEP 6 - Grams:
- apple 336 ml x 0.6 = 180 g
- grapes 106 ml x 0.6 = 64 g
- cantaloupe 106 ml x 0.6 = 64 g
- total 308 g
STEP 7 - Energy:
- apple 180 g x 52/100 = 94 kcal
- grapes 64 g x 69/100 = 44 kcal
- cantaloupe 64 g x 34/100 = 22 kcal
- total 160 kcal
STEP 8 - Sanity: 27% plate coverage, ~300 g and ~160 kcal, plausible for one apple plus fruit portions
